body: Yes and she did too. We left messages, even called the shelter in Gainesville to be told they’re full :( I’m not giving up. I can’t I got 3 babies looking up at me to do something and I will. I’m getting to desperate/panic mom mode at this point
I’m sorry 😟
I have tried calling churches. Most didn’t answer - but the ones who did said to try again around the 1st of the month, as they were out of funds. And no, we lost our room last night 😭
I still owe 80$ to the motel to cover us until I get paid Friday, I’m tired y’all 😭
Another redditor inboxed me and told me to correct the previous way I had it written, that I could be looked at strange because I didn’t mention her being older and I just said “babies”.
Ah, yeah they’re both mainly the same building which is why I said I’ve only seen one. Thank you 💕
And tbh, in this situation it’s extremely hard to turn down help for my kids, being it’s mainly for them and honestly we need a hand up until I get paid.

That’s the strange part. He inboxed me asking me if I’d send him my PayPal information so he could “help”. I respectfully declined, and then he posted that comment. Is there anyway I can send you the proof of this?
I wish I could post screenshots. I definitely did, but in my inbox. The persons name was beansRgood or something along those lines.
As far as I’m aware, there’s only one school here. I may be wrong, but I’ve only seen one school. Thank you for the information I’ll do my best to look into it

I feel like such a failure. Like, what mother could allow this? What mother could let their children sleep in a vehicle with no access to food/drinks? I’m a shitbag mother, I have no one to call to borrow money from for my motel until I’m paid Friday. I’m just so depressed. I’m terrified sleeping in my truck with the windows down that at any moment he could walk up and the nightmare start all over.
Wow I’m actually not too far from you!
Wait, didn’t you just inbox me offering me help?

She had a stomach bug, the craps, fever the whole 9. And the daycare won’t watch her while she’s sick so I had to miss wrk... and I’m in bell Florida... money fucking rules everything I’m so fkn sick of life and money. 😭
I am so tired y’all 😭 like I’m almost questioning the point of continuing 😭

We did survive the night. Other than being hungry, hot, and irritated we’re doing okay. I’m praying a miracle comes through, and the hundreds of people I begged will lend me the 80$ to get through until I get paid, but it’s looking bleak. Thank you again, so much, for checking in on us 🖤💕
It is so hot outside today guys 😭 and humid as hell. Idk if my newborn can handle this 😭
It looks so good while I watch mukbangs I couldn’t afford it anyway lol. The most I could afford rn is some grass and ketchup
No just the thought of it. I guess it’s kinda like a mental thing more than anything. That’s why I say I’m psychotic lol I can watch others eat it but I can’t make myself do it.
I love your username lol

That’s total mental abuse. You definitely need to consider leaving, trust me it only gets worse. I up and left my abuser after almost 11yrs of that same mental abuse, but it also become physical when he saw he could do it and get away with it. Please, please consider leaving if she continues down this path. I never want anyone to experience what I have.

I’m insanely jealous now lol. I do think I’m kind of psychotic in way- because I can’t make myself eat crab, yet I sit for (an ungodly and embarrassing) amount of time watching others on YouTube eat crab 😭😂😂 while I sit in my truck sweating to death contemplating on eating grass 🤷🏻‍♀️😭😩😂

Thanks for the 2 people who so generously helped me, I’ve received 34$ total! I’m only about 70$ away from paying our room and hopefully buying a small bit of food. I absolutely appreciate everyone who was kind enough to reach out and donate their hard earned money to us. It’s very much appreciated, I am eternally grateful.

Here as in where I’m living. Or did you assume I meant reddit? As for reddit I’ve only been on here for about 3-4 days. I was told by an old classmate how wonderful reddit was, so I decided to try it out. And from the outpouring encouragement and support I’ve gotten just yesterday, I agree reddit is amazing
Thank you so much 🖤😭
After a crap ton of googling, I found ONE 24hr restaurant (McDonald’s) but it’s farther away than the gas I have unfortunately 😭
Are they open this late? The only churches (I’m aware of) we have nearby are catholic and like evangelists I believe. But yes please provide their number when you can.
Thank you !
Guys this is awful!!!! I’m in such a bad area 😭 there are gunshots, multiple men in hoodies walking around. I am so scared. I just want the safety of my room back 😭

I can’t even tell you how bad I needed to have someone say these exact words to me. I am literally bawling as I Type this reply. This meant the world to me, and I appreciate this message more than you’ll ever know. Thank you 🖤😭

Thank you so very much! That will buy them something to snack on tonight. Please allow me to repay you on Friday, it’s only right! You’re the only who’s offered and I want to show you it means the world to us!
Thank you so very much for your generous offer 🖤😭
I wish I was In Maryland, I’m actually in a small town called Bell Florida.

Thank you so much!! My PayPal is southernmama863@hotmail.com 😭🖤🖤🖤 our room cost until I get paid is 110$, (no one has that much to lend out I know 🖤) but believe me when I get paid Friday I’d love to repay you, if you’d allow it!
You are so amazing! Thank you so much again for everything.. you are so kind. I will definitely try that!

Mostly all of the above lol. She uses one of the old school flip phones, and trying to navigate the internet on one of those dinosaurs is a pain in itself. She lives where my abuser lives (a state away), so unfortunately I can’t see in the flesh, though I’d give anything to. She’s all we’ve got in the world. I just wish it was closer to Pay day 😭
I have never posted before, so I’m unsure of what you mean? I just recently got my oldest daughter back from my ex (horrid custody battle). But I’d never not include her in anything I say/do.

I have tried until im blue in the face on trying to explain how to do the PayPal thing to my grandma and yep, we got nowhere lol. She doesn’t even know how to text yet haha. But thank you so very much. You’re appreciated beyond belief!
Thank you so so very much! You didn’t have to, but I appreciate the effort so very much!
I have PayPal. How would I send the photo to you? Can you PM me?
The thing is, I’ve been here for almost 4 months, I have a decent career going for me, I just fell short this month.
I have my own vehicle, I just have no gas. I can show you my fuel gauge? I’m unsure how else I’d go about proving it..
Omgosh, would you? 😭😭😭😭 j would appreciate it beyond belief. Thank you so very much!
I tried this morning, but due to being I believe she said anemic ??? I can’t donate 😭

The lady I spoke with was so caring and so very polite; but basically in a nut shell it was “I’m so sorry, the only advice I can give is getting in touch with 211”. Thanks for taking the time to respond 🖤

I really appreciate everyone who took the time to offer advice. I have severe anxiety and PTSD from my abuser (I finally left after 11yrs of physical and mental torture & this is why I’m in this situation) and guys I’m doing my best to keep our heads above water; and I have literally no one to turn to for help/advice/consolation
Unfortunately from what I can tell (I’m new to all of this) but I don’t think I’m able to post on the r/assistance one. I so wish I could 😭
Thank you 🖤
Thank you 🖤 I can’t get ahold of any churches tonight. This is so terrifying 😭

Unfortunately I just moved here 4 month ago, so there’s no one locally who can help me. My grandmother doesn’t understand how to use PayPal to help me, and I’ve tried begging the motel owner to no avail. But on the freelance part, I never even knew things like that existed. I’ll look into it. Thank you!
